title: Vanishing of derived tensor cohomology of two derived objects
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E,L\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For $i\in\mathbf Z$, the predicate $H^i(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)=0$ means that there exist cochain complexes $K,N$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with $K$ K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], and isomorphisms $Q(K)\cong E$, $Q(N)\cong L$ in the derived category, such that the cohomology sheaf $H^i(\operatorname{Tot}(K\otimes N))$ [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules] is zero. The total tensor is [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and $Q$ is the localization functor. This extends the module-second-factor predicate [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes] to an arbitrary derived second factor; K-flat replacement and independence of representatives identify it with derived tensor cohomology vanishing.
